name: Holdout: monthly rotation with a MACD filter

sections.hypothesis: Monthly rotation with a MACD filter (180 days) does not lose to BTC held at its own exposure on the holdout year, 2025-11 to 2026-10.
sections.rationale: On watch (2026-11-15) after passing 7 of 9 scorecard tests (Sharpe 1.41 vs 0.74 for BTC; fails drawdown by 0.7 points and luck at 57%). Stated before the run, and the reason this test is one-sided: the holdout is not unseen for this strategy. The MACD filter was proposed after the plain rotation's holdout failure (-31.5% vs -6.6% for BTC at its exposure), knowing that year fell and that the losses came from holding ETH and SOL. A trend filter is likely to have avoided some of that, so a pass is expected and carries little weight. A fail, despite that knowledge, would be strong evidence against it.
sections.rules: Implementation monthly-rotation: lookback_days 180, trend_days 200, top_n 2, macd_filter 1. The coin universe, daily bars, 330 USDT, costs from kestrel.toml. Warm-up from 2024-11-01; scored 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31. Command: kestrel holdout-test UNIVERSE --strategy monthly-rotation --research <this note> --warmup-start 2024-11 --start 2025-11 --end 2026-10 --param lookback_days=180 --param macd_filter=1.
sections.falsification: The holdout rule (falling year: return must beat BTC held at the strategy's average exposure; worst drawdown within 50%). One-sided, agreed in advance: a FAIL means Claude recommends drop and Luke decides; a PASS changes nothing (it stays watch, and paper trading remains the test that counts). Run once; recorded in data/holdout and decisions.toml whatever it is.
sections.parameters: lookback_days 180, trend_days 200, top_n 2, macd_filter 1. Nothing else.
sections.costs: About 22 bps a round trip on BTC and ETH, wider on SOL. Holdout runs are never trials.

history.reason: Cleanup (Luke, 2026-11-15): monthly rotation is dropped; this note stays as evidence on its decision.
